unit: U2 · paper-mouth puppet and kinetic type (mouth-shape designer + pose library + typesetter)
revision: U2-r2 (rebuilt from the approved test shot with the user's fixes)
timing_note: MEASURED (editor E3, 2026-11-17): the film drives the rig from U1's cue_timeline.json audio.film_time S1/S3/S6/S8 syllables and visemes, measured as sample positions in the real 16-word Lingua Libre assembly (all four lines, line 3 included). The U2 placeholders (provisional_onsets.json) are no longer used. Editor adds: every MBP closure held >= 0.17 s (>= 2 frames on twos), so the medial p of 'popcorn' closes.

api.mouth_layer: mouth_layer(t, track, lip_set='A'|'B'|callable) -> PIL RGBA 960x540, transparent field; 12 fps on twos (pose and jaw sampled on even 24 fps frames)
api.make_track: make_track(events, breaths, seconds) -> Track; decodes once (#38); Track.frame(t)->(pose,jaw)
api.film_events: film_events(timeline=None) -> (events, onsets_by_section, status) for S1/S3/S8 + gestures
api.decode: decode(targets, min_hold=2, on_twos=True) -> pose id per 24 fps frame
api.type_layer: type_layer(t, syllable_onsets, glyph_table=GLYPHS, ink=1, darken=None, cursor=True) -> RGBA
api.underline_layer: underline_layer(t, t0=52.0, t1=54.0) -> RGBA (red pencil under 'hangs', two strokes)
api.usage: ev, on, st = M.film_events(); tr = M.make_track(ev, M.BREATHS, 66); frame.alpha_composite(M.mouth_layer(t, tr, M.lip_set_at(t))); frame.alpha_composite(M.type_layer(t, on['S3'])) ...

handmade.what: articulated cut-paper mouth in profile facing right: skin upper face with nose base, ala and nostril (washi base sheet + tissue under-sheets: cheek pad, philtrum column, ala), upper lip (substitution), lower lip (substitution) with glaze sheen and soft glints, upper teeth strip, lower teeth, cavity, tongue hint (2 drawings), jaw/chin group (chin pad + labiomental crease tissue), neck
handmade.where: films/swarm/le-maki-mococo/mouth_rig.py (geometry tables HEAD, ALA, JAW, ...; class Rig)
handmade.method: original landmark geometry, Catmull-Rom outline + scissor-wobble facets, anti-aliased masks, glue-dome relief lit soft frontal-left from above, under-sheet ridges and tint, long kozo fibres + cloudy formation (skin only), crepe striations on lip paper, lit cut edges, small warm cast shadows; jaw groups on one FK pin at HINGE (-250, 40), clamp 0-10 deg
handmade.not_traced: geometry placed by eye from anatomy; maki.webp was only measured (palette/luma/framing)

handmade.what: two lip-paper colourways: A warm rose, B cool mauve
poem typeset in Caladea 30 px (OFL system font), warm ink #2a2422, rose cursor, letters landing on syllable onsets in 3 frames; column x 455-735, y 120-330
two-stroke red-pencil underline under 'hangs' with pressure and paper-tooth skips
kit Mix.room in mouth_test.mp4 (declared synth, not speech)

decoder.method: Viterbi over 24 fps frames; states (pose, held>=2); switches only on even frames (on twos) and only from a held state (min hold 2 frames); transition cost 0.15 + 0.10*|openness diff| + 0.6 for open<->closed (A/surprise <-> MBP/hm); match cost 1-sim, x3 for a mismatched key pose (O, surprise, MBP) so closures and the surprise are never averaged away
decoder.paths_source: E4: the render's own decoded path (films/le-maki-mococo.py TRACK, sampled on twos) over the voice spans {"S1": [2.0, 12.19], "S3": [15.5, 25.69], "S6": [41.0, 41.77], "S8": [52.0, 55.08]}

gestures.note: E4: the film's gestures, timed from the staged responses: S2 'hm' at R1-0.2 (12.425, after the voice ends at 12.19), then a slight open; S4 lip set B + jaw eases to 2.8 deg from R2-0.2; S6 slow surprise; S7 'O' then closes; one breath in S0, one slow breath in S5

type.note: boxes are a pure function of the frozen poem string (poem-r1); invariant: assert glyph_table() == GLYPHS on every frame

targets.skin_max_x_frac: < 0.45, cut by top and bottom edges
targets.dark: cavity is the only dark mass (luma<80 <= 4% of frame)

notes: dark_inside_cavity_frac = share of luma<80 pixels inside the cavity mask (whole frame incl. type); outside it are only the nostril and lip-corner crease lines; in the compare frame the poem's ink is also <80

fixes vs approved test shot: softer modelled skin (glue-dome relief + tissue under-sheets, long visible fibres, no flat speckle); thinner, lighter upper lip; more teeth (extended premolar strip, taller incisors, lower teeth), cavity lighter toward the front and only deep at the back; gloss is a soft glaze sheen + glints, no sticker strip

timing_note_U2: PROVISIONAL: U1's cue_timeline.json was not present when U2 ran. L1 onsets are measured from the CC0 Lingua Libre assembly (envelope onset/nucleus/coda); L2-L4 in S1/S3 are ESTIMATED placeholders (0.16 s syllables). mouth_rig.film_events() switches to cue_timeline.json automatically when it exists (audio.syllables / audio.sections[S1|S3|S8] with seg_id + onset/offset).
revision_E3: editor repair round 1: pieces re-made as stacked flat cut-paper sheets (tone quantised into cut steps with lit edges and cast shadows), paper formation grain + fibres on lips and skin, stronger scissor wobble (WOBBLE 1.7), the airbrushed specular glaze replaced by a separate cut glazed-tissue sheet, cavity trimmed behind the tucked F/V lip, framing ZOOM 1.35 about the lip front (432,150)
revision_E4: editor repair round 2: teeth rebuilt as separate cut cream-card tooth pieces (own scissor edge, fibre, lit edge, small shadow on the tooth behind); decoder paths and gestures regenerated from the render; mouth_rig.gesture_events() retimed to the staged responses
